segments.an9.26:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca candikāputto rājagahe viharanti veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.an9.26:1.3: Tatra kho āyasmā candikāputto bhikkhū āmantesi ()[(āvuso … pe … etadavoca)(sī.)]–
segments.an9.26:1.5: ‘yato kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno cetasā citaṃ hoti, tassetaṃ bhikkhuno kallaṃ veyyākaraṇāya –
segments.an9.26:1.6: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī’”ti.
segments.an9.26:2.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ candikāputtaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an9.26:2.2: “na kho, āvuso candikāputta, devadatto bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti –
segments.an9.26:2.3: ‘yato kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno cetasā citaṃ hoti, tassetaṃ bhikkhuno kallaṃ veyyākaraṇāya –
segments.an9.26:2.4: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī’ti.
segments.an9.26:2.5: Evañca kho, āvuso, candikāputta, devadatto bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti –
segments.an9.26:2.6: ‘yato kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti, tassetaṃ bhikkhuno kallaṃ veyyākaraṇāya –
segments.an9.26:2.7: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī’”ti.

segments.an9.26:5.1: “Kathañca, āvuso, bhikkhuno cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti?
segments.an9.26:5.2: ‘Vītarāgaṃ me cittan’ti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti;
segments.an9.26:5.3: ‘vītadosaṃ me cittan’ti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti;
segments.an9.26:5.4: ‘vītamohaṃ me cittan’ti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti;
segments.an9.26:5.5: ‘asarāgadhammaṃ me cittan’ti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti;
segments.an9.26:5.6: ‘asadosadhammaṃ me cittan’ti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti;
segments.an9.26:5.7: ‘asamohadhammaṃ me cittan’ti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti;
segments.an9.26:5.8: ‘anāvattidhammaṃ me cittaṃ kāmabhavāyā’ti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti;
segments.an9.26:5.9: ‘anāvattidhammaṃ me cittaṃ rūpabhavāyā’ti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti;
segments.an9.26:5.10: ‘anāvattidhammaṃ me cittaṃ arūpabhavāyā’ti cetasā cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
segments.an9.26:5.11: Evaṃ sammā vimuttacittassa kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno bhusā cepi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti;
segments.an9.26:5.12: amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ, vayaṃ cassānupassati.
segments.an9.26:6.2: Tassassu aṭṭha kukkū heṭṭhā nemaṅgamā, aṭṭha kukkū upari nemassa.
segments.an9.26:6.3: Atha puratthimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, neva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampavedheyya;
segments.an9.26:6.6: atha dakkhiṇāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, neva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampavedheyya.
segments.an9.26:6.9: Evamevaṃ kho, āvuso, sammā vimuttacittassa bhikkhuno bhusā cepi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti;
segments.an9.26:6.10: amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ, vayaṃ cassānupassati.
segments.an9.26:7.5: manoviññeyyā dhammā manassa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti;
segments.an9.26:7.6: amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ, vayaṃ cassānupassatī”ti.

lines: Cetasā cittaṃ hotīti cittavārapariyāyena cittavārapariyāyo cito vaḍḍhito hoti.
Cetasā cittaṃ suparicitanti cittavārapariyāyena cittavārapariyāyo uparūpari sucito suvaḍḍhito hoti.
Nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyantīti tāni ārammaṇāni tassa khīṇāsavassa cittuppādaṃ gahetvā khepetvā ṭhātuṃ na sakkonti.

Evameva khoti ettha silāyūpo viya khīṇāsavo daṭṭhabbo, mahāvātā viya chasu dvāresu uppajjanakā kilesā, catūhi disāhi āgantvā vātānaṃ silāyūpaṃ cāletuṃ asamatthabhāvo viya chasu dvāresu uppajjanakakilesānaṃ khīṇāsavassa cittaṃ cāletuṃ asamatthabhāvo veditabbo.
Chaṭṭhe pamāṇamajjhimassa purisassa catuvīsataṅguliko hattho kukku,“kakkū” tipi tasseva nāmaṃ.
Aṭṭha kukkū upari nemassāti aṭṭha hatthā āvāṭassa upari uggantvā ṭhitā bhaveyyuṃ.
